definition: Relatedness needs are a person’s needs for social connection and a sense of being meaningfully linked with others. In this context, they refer to how well those connection needs are being satisfied, which may be insufficient in some online social interaction settings.

reasons: The packet does not define “relatedness needs” as social connection or as a sense of being meaningfully linked with others; it only mentions their satisfaction in an online social interaction context.
